content.what_it_is: A CUDA-specific Makefile for preprocessing, compiling, linking, archiving, cleaning, and moving a FUNWAVE-GPU executable. The active configuration builds funwave_fullcuda with nvfortran in single precision, Cartesian mode, USE_CUDA and PGI macros, targets GPU architecture cc120 with cuSPARSE, and includes CUDA support modules plus GPU kernels in the module source group (lines 1-119).
entities: Core shell, preprocessor, and executable variables (lines 1-4)
Precision and feature macro selection block (lines 5-30)
.F to .o preprocessing and compilation suffix rule (lines 66-74)
FUNWAVE-TVD module/GPU and main source groups (lines 75-92)

unresolved: CPPARGS references FLAG_1 through FLAG_24, but most are commented out and FLAG_5 plus FLAG_22-FLAG_24 have no definitions in this Makefile (lines 11-30, 51-57); their empty or externally supplied resolution is not documented.

INCS and LIBS definitions are commented out (lines 62-63), and LDFLAGS is not defined in this file, although the compile/link recipes reference INCS, LDFLAGS, and LIBS (lines 73, 98); their external or empty resolution is unspecified.
The move target is a hard-coded relative user/work path, ../yuan/rip_2d/work (line 119), with no creation or portability handling in the Makefile.
